    StartersCheddar & Onion RollsA pull-apart pan, baked this morning with sharp cheese on top.Good for dunking in the stew.How to make it1 onion, sliced70g butter500g bread flour7g dried yeast1 tsp salt1 tsp sugar300ml warm milk150g sharp cheddar, gratedFry the onion in some of the butter until golden.Mix the flour, yeast, salt, sugar, warm milk and the rest of the melted butter. Knead.Rise in a covered bowl until doubled.Knead in the onion and most of the cheddar. Shape 12 rolls and pack into a tin.Rise again.Top with the remaining cheddar and bake at 200°C.Manhole Cover PizzasLittle rounds of tomato sauce and mozzarella, pepperoni in a crosshatch.Cut like the covers out front.How to make it500g pizza dough150ml pizza sauce150g mozzarella, grated80g pepperoniRoll the dough thin and cut 12 rounds.Spread with sauce and top with mozzarella.Slice the pepperoni into thin strips and lay them in a crosshatch like a manhole grate.Bake at 230°C until bubbling.MainsBeef StewChuck braised for hours with carrot, celery, onion and potato. Italian bread.What's left goes to the Reverend's shelter.How to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions, chopped3 carrots, chopped2 celery sticks, chopped2 tbsp tomato paste1 L beef stock600g potatoes, in chunks1 loaf Italian bread2 tbsp oilBrown the beef in batches in oil.Add the onions, carrots, celery and tomato paste and cook.Add the stock, cover and braise at 160°C.Add the potatoes and braise for the last hour.Serve with Italian bread.SweetsCider DoughnutsBoiled-down apple juice in the batter, rolled in cinnamon sugar.Seconds once everybody has had firsts.How to make it500ml apple juice60g butter, melted1 egg100g sugar250g self-raising flour1 L vegetable oil for frying100g caster sugar1 tsp ground cinnamonSimmer the apple juice until reduced to a quarter and cool.Mix with the butter, egg, sugar and flour into a soft dough.Pat out and cut 12 rings.Fry in oil at 175°C, turning once.Toss in caster sugar and cinnamon.DrinksLime CoolerLime cordial and tonic water over a glass full of ice.Glows green under the sign.How to make it160ml lime cordial1 L tonic water1kg icePour cordial into four tall glasses over ice.Top with tonic water and switch off the lights so it glows under a black light.
